user_query: Identify this protein and describe its enzymatic catalytic activity, especially the chemical reaction catalyzed. Distinguish direct curated annotation from homology-based inference and report evidence limitations.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation.organism: Desulforamulus reducens (strain ATCC BAA-1160 / DSM 100696 / MI-1)
